title: Alexander "AE" Edwards Responds To Amber Rose's Allegations [Watch]
htmlContent:
According to People Magazine, Amber Rose accused her partner, Last Kings Records music Executive Alexander "AE" Edwards, of cheating on her with at least 12 different individuals.

The 37-year-old founder of Slut Walk shared a scathing message on her Instagram Stories on Wednesday, writing, "I'm tired of getting cheated on and being embarrassed behind the scenes."

"All 12 of y'all bums (the ones that I know of there's probably more) can have him," said Rose

Both Rose and Edwards share a 22-month-old son, which, according to Rose, these ladies knew.

"Y'all very much knew he was in a relationship with a baby and y'all decided to f--- him anyway. I saw all the texts and DM's. Y'all were well aware, but y'all don't owe me any loyalty so it's whatever."

"I can't be the only one fighting for my family anymore. I've been so loyal and transparent, but I haven't got the same energy in return," she wrote. "As for him... The lack of loyalty and the disrespect is ridiculous and I'm done."

While Rose refused to name the people involved, explaining she was "not in the business of ruining lives." However, she implied that her relationship is over because of the so-called cheating.

Well, now it's time for Edwards to respond and shared his side. So, he hopped in the IG Live chat with Big Von of 106kmel, DaBoyDame, and shared his side of the story.

"She wanted a baby. She got pregnant on a Plan B God's Plan. 12 was something light," Edward said.

Then he hopped on the Live and the first thing Edwards said, "I woke up to text messages from n**** I ain't heard from in a minute, who were considered about me and said I caught. I mean, I got caught before, but I guess she had enough."

Apparently, the girls he talked to turned into Rose's fans, and they just came clean. He said that he still loves Roses, and she loves him, but he doesn't want to force things back together. He also doesn't want her to look over her shoulder; every time the phone goes off, it is 13 or 14. But, in true Playa fashion, he said all twelve are off his roster.

According to Edwards, he and Rose were only together for four months, and she got pregnant, but she had an abortion, and her gynecologist gave her plan b pills, "and I think the second plan b pill she took, she didn't get her period and still got pregnant."

Hopefully, the couple can figure things out and come to a happy medium moving forward.
